<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that forms a sulfonamide (functional group “sulfonamides”) from a sulfonyl‑type precursor. The forward reaction creates a sulfonamide, so we look for templates where “sulfonamides” is listed as a functional group formed. The sulfonyl chloride precursor can be approximated by the “acyl chloride” functional group, which is available in the catalog. Using these criteria should return the appropriate template, after which we can retrieve its mapped reaction SMILES and template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(c2ccc(O)cc2)(c2ccc(O)cc2)c2ccccc21",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["acyl chloride"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
